name: @kitchensink/code-quality-toolchain
description: Pinned scanner toolchain run by the CI `codeQuality` job and read by the GATE. Lives OUTSIDE the npm workspaces so its exact pins never touch the root install. EXACT pins: a scanner whose verdict moves on someone else's release schedule is not a gate. eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y and eslint-plugin-react do not yet declare ESLint 10 peer support, hence --legacy-peer-deps; both were verified working on ESLint 10.9.1 on 2026-09-13.
